demands.name: Recognize social property
demands.withers: the deed regime that knows only a named owner
demands.becomes: a social-property title class — purpose-owned, asset-locked, no beneficial owner

demands.name: Hold the means of life in common
demands.withers: the title that lets a few hold the land, tools, housing, and food the many must live by
demands.becomes: social stewardship of the means of life — held in common, allocated by use, no beneficial owner

demands.name: Retire rent
demands.withers: the levy on shelter — payment for access to housing someone else holds title to
demands.becomes: housing as a commons: maintained and coordinated by those who live there — no rent, no eviction

demands.name: Retire debt
demands.withers: credit as an enforceable claim on the future — interest, seniority, the obligation to pay
demands.becomes: mutual credit: resources advanced and obligations recorded by the commons, without interest or coercion

demands.name: Withdraw extractive taxation
demands.withers: the levy on a self-provisioning commons
demands.becomes: the commons funds its own metabolism; the levy is duress, not contribution

demands.name: End state money
demands.becomes: the commons transacts in its own unit — credit and socially-necessary labour-time

demands.name: Pull the border inside
demands.withers: the jurisdiction levy on people and goods
demands.becomes: free association across the line — international solidarity as a setting, not a sentiment

demands.name: Retire prisons
demands.becomes: transformative justice — repair priced as an economic option, not vengeance

demands.name: Reform the courts
demands.becomes: elective, revocable arbiters; standing (the suable party) kept as the residual interface

demands.name: Retire the police
demands.withers: the monopoly on public safety and dispute-force
demands.becomes: safety as a commons function — the police a revocable agent, then superfluous

demands.name: Retire the standing army
demands.becomes: defense as a commons function — the people in arms, no standing army to turn on them

demands.name: Make rights material
demands.withers: formal permission without the means to use it
demands.becomes: the means placed at the people's disposal — presses, halls, airtime, the time to take part

demands.name: Self-determination & decolonisation
demands.withers: imperial extraction, occupation, and imposed administration
demands.becomes: peoples govern themselves; voluntary federation, not colonial control

demands.name: Repudiate odious debt
demands.withers: the obligation to service extractive and inherited debt
demands.becomes: the commons keeps its own books; legitimate mutual obligations honored, odious ones annulled

demands.name: Separate church from state
demands.withers: the established creed and church-run schooling
demands.becomes: secular provision + freedom of conscience — no state religion, no church-run school
